instruction: Move all files in the "/tmp/test_files" directory tree that were last modified 30 days ago to a new directory called "/tmp/old_archive"

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'ARCHIVE_COUNT=$(find /tmp/old_archive -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); OLD_REMAIN=$(find /tmp/test_files/old_files -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); NEW_COUNT=$(find /tmp/test_files/new_files -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$ARCHIVE_COUNT" -eq 2 ] && [ "$OLD_REMAIN" -eq 0 ] && [ "$NEW_COUNT" -eq 2 ]; then echo "Success: Old files moved to archive, new files preserved"; else echo "Fail: ARCHIVE=$ARCHIVE_COUNT OLD_REMAIN=$OLD_REMAIN NEW=$NEW_COUNT"; fi'

include: Success: Old files moved to archive, new files preserved
